answers.answer: On Linux copy gpt-6-astra/skills/delegate into ~/.agents/skills (so ~/.agents/skills/delegate/SKILL.md exists; ~/.codex/skills if your client lists skills from the Codex home). License: the repository has no LICENSE file and GitHub detects no license, so no reuse license is granted.

Download simple-gemini-0.1.1.zip from the downloads/ folder (https://workingyuanyuan.github.io/simple-gemini-public/downloads/simple-gemini-0.1.1.zip), extract it and Load unpacked in chrome://extensions. It is NOT the latest GitHub release: the only GitHub release is v0.1.0 (asset simple-gemini-0.1.0.zip); 0.1.1 is only in the downloads folder.

Yes: the actual repository is local-tts-sfx, and the README's workingyuanyuan/local-tts.git name resolves on GitHub to it. Speech weights need about 16.5 GiB in ~/.cache/huggingface (plus ~7.3 GiB for .venv; optional sound effects add ~11 GiB). Fully tested only on an RTX 5090 Laptop GPU with 24 GB under WSL2; a 16 GB card was not tested.

A long narration returns status pending with a job_id and a next field: call the tool named in next (get_speech_job) with exactly those arguments until done. It should not resend or resubmit the text; if the job_id is lost, list_speech_jobs recovers it.

No, not directly: Kage output is HTML for screens only, and SKILL.md says PDF (and native Office files, light designs) needs a different deliverable. Only Node.js is required (no dependencies), and Chrome or Edge for screenshot and pixel checks (set KAGE_CHROME if not found); no PDF tooling is documented.

Cause: your Obsidian installer version is older than 1.4.5, so its built-in browser engine does not understand the colour-mixing CSS syntax the theme uses, making highlight backgrounds transparent. Fix: download and run the current Obsidian installer again (vault is untouched); check under Settings, About, Installer version.

No, Firefox is not supported: it needs Chrome or Edge because saving uses the File System Access API that Firefox and Safari lack. The highest level is 10; each level takes 3 points, with a maximum of 30 points per term, so 30 points reaches level 10.

Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 and API Key none (or any characters), with LLM provider ChatGPT or Ollama. License: the README says MIT, but the repository has no LICENSE file and GitHub detects no license.

Run ./install.ps1 -InstallDelegationTrigger from the project root, on Windows 11 only (PowerShell 7). The runner's -AutoApprove lets Antigravity run tools without asking, and the separate working directory is not a file system sandbox, so it could modify files beyond the worktree.

No, it is not safe to deploy as is: passwords are stored as plain text, SQL is built by string interpolation, and the default DB account is root with an empty password (also admin/admin default login, a committed venv, no license). Install opencv-contrib-python, since plain opencv-python may lack the cv2.face module.
